notes: four «ح» / «وحدثناه» branches are four groups that meet at «كلهم عن هشام»; the text writes هشام and the back reference once, so they are the shared tail
«يعني ابن مسهر» is an editor gloss and is left out
«ابن نمير» (in the list) and «عبد الله بن نمير» (after «عن») are written as the text writes them; not merged
«وفي حديث أبي أسامة إذا طلع الفجر» is a variant wording of the matn, not a route
